rules.description: Production planner/router, intent heuristics, prompt text and private evaluation cases. The src package is the governed hook implementation; old app modules remain compatibility snapshots until separately approved cutover.
Private tooling, runtime compatibility and production planner regressions.
Common policy utilities and regression suites; maintain identical copies in both repositories independently of the runtime pin.
Private repository enforcement and the temporary bridge to public execution. Shared startup/ownership utilities are vendored from public.
Temporary import/application bootstrap and test-package/fixture shims; each retained shim needs a manifest exception.
Public app and implementation tests. Private copies remain only for runtime compatibility until separately approved cutover; the Active migration freeze still applies.
Platform, governed arithmetic, evidence/claim validation, read adapters and other application code; no new private copies.
Shared harness and platform tooling. Private repository tooling is maintained in its owning repository, outside the application-copy check.

mixed_capabilities.private: Production prompt text is supplied through the selected provider. Existing legacy compatibility prompts are frozen pending legacy-route migration.

mixed_capabilities.public: Shared execution and schema now live in app/agent/plan_execution.py; literal scope and conversation guards in app/agent/scope_policy.py. The reference provider is app/agent/reference_planner.py.
mixed_capabilities.private: Production planning only; private version delegates the shared functions.
